{{Combat}} {{RaceIcon|DragonBlack}} [[Onyxia]] |territory=Contested }} '''Dustwallow Marsh''' (or '''Dustwallow Swamp'''){{Horde}} [43+] [[Overlord Mok'Morokk's Concern]] is a vast and ancient swamp in the eastern reaches of [[Central Kalimdor]]. Navigation is often extremely difficult and many adventurers have lost their way in this great jungle, where trees obscure the sunlight and [[raptor]]s, [[spider]]s, and [[crocolisk]]s lie in wait, hunting those brave enough to venture close to their lairs. Although there is little activity in the area, the Alliance and the Horde have recently expanded their influence in the region. The [[Alliance]] city-state of [[Theramore]] is located on a small island east off shore, and the Horde's primary foothold in the area is [[Brackenwall Village]], the new home of the ogre [[Stonemaul clan]]. == Geography == The raid dungeon [[Onyxia's Lair]] and the micro dungeon [[Alcaz Island]] can be found in this area. No other dungeons or battlegrounds are located here. === Maps and subregions === [[File:WorldMap-Dustwallow.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Map of Dustwallow Marsh]] WorldMap-Dustwallow-old2.jpg|Map of Dustwallow Marsh prior to [[patch 1.16.4]].
